selection: Newer consumer apps made by individual developers or small studios, including focused utilities, lifestyle tools and social/party games. User references: HabitKit, WhoLiked and Imposter Who.
market_rationale: Uniformly expand from six English-language markets to twenty accessible storefronts covering European maker/home markets and additional consumer markets. Preserve all original languages; do not use market as a language or residence label.
uncertain_makers: Imposter Who is an explicit user-nominated reference with verified identity/age but unverified small-team independence; label separately and do not silently count as qualified indie evidence.
legacy_sample: ../app-store-indie-reviews; retained unchanged as an earlier, out-of-scope cohort. Its review counts do not contribute to this cohort's headline target.
